scope: Standing primary Upper Reservoir Dam, including its granite-faced gravity wall, 1897 crest raise, inspection walkway, masonry shoulders and plant-free apron.
geometryBasis: Mapped dam way 448005771 and its shared upstream shoreline with the named Upper Reservoir. The crest and outer shoulders use documented and mapped extents.
sectionBasis: Granite-faced concrete gravity section with upper narrowing, rough stone courses, dressed coping and double-bar railing. The original independent terrain establishes the toe and reveals the 30 m central relief.
limitations: The guide gives a 121.9 m main dam, and the appraisal gives about 150 m including its broader extent. The mapped slope and shared shoreline guide the model. The inspection walkway and individual course details remain estimated.

The published full water elevation is 152.31 m HKPD. The top and toe follow the unmodified original terrain and documented gravity section. The 1897 change is represented by the estimated raised crest and pale coping.
The historic valve house is an independently placed structure on part of the crest. The separate overflow works are beyond this dam’s physical footprint.

facts.masonry: roughly coursed with dressed ashlar copings
facts.rails: two round bars on inverted T stanchions
